ambiguities.text: Security analysis section states 'Needs discussion' - security implications not fully specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume wallets should treat all dapp-provided ABIs as untrusted and clearly indicate to users when ABI source is not verified

ambiguities.text: 'Wallets MAY validate provided specs against trusted databases' does not specify what databases or validation criteria
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this refers to databases like 4byte.directory, Sourcify, or Etherscan verified contracts

ambiguities.text: Case-sensitive address comparison is specified but Ethereum addresses are typically case-insensitive (EIP-55 checksum)
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume exact string match is required; dapps must provide addresses in the exact case format used in the calls

implicit_assumptions.description: DApps provide accurate ABI specifications that correctly describe the contract functions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users could be tricked into approving transactions that perform different actions than displayed (blind signing with false labels)

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot easily construct calldata that decodes to innocent-looking functions while actually calling malicious ones
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Sophisticated attackers could craft transactions that appear benign but perform malicious operations

implicit_assumptions.description: Wallets have access to reliable trusted ABI databases for verification
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Wallets cannot verify ABI authenticity, leaving users vulnerable to misleading dapps

implicit_assumptions.description: Users understand that decoded transaction details are only as trustworthy as the dapp providing them
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may over-trust decoded displays and approve malicious transactions without scrutiny
